xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-5083: Telemetry: record which MCP protocol revisions, clients and surfaces are used (PostHog)

plan.title: Telemetry: record which MCP protocol revisions, clients and surfaces are used (PostHog)
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

narratives.Problem: PostHog has no MCP event, so the operator cannot see which MCP protocol revisions, clients and surfaces use Overdeck, and cannot time the 2026-07-28 migration (PAN-5082) on data.
narratives.Proposal: Add two closed-enum events, mcp_session_seen (surface, requested protocol, bucketed client, credential kind) and mcp_tool_called (surface, client, tool; presence per day), through one tracker module src/lib/telemetry/mcp.ts with a pure classifier. HTTP surfaces observe the raw body and header before the SDK transport (so refused 2026-07-28 requests count); stdio surfaces observe via an onmessage accessor; tool calls are recorded in server.ts. Dedupe per UTC day in memory plus a ~/.overdeck ledger for dashboard and stdio surfaces. Contract, docs tables, privacy and drift tests, user docs and PostHog insight definitions ship together.
narratives.NonGoals:
- Creating the PostHog dashboard inside the PR (post-merge operator step)
- Moving to MCP SDK v2 or answering 2026-07-28 requests (PAN-5082)
- Telemetry for the Channels bridge MCP server (src/lib/channels/overdeck-bridge.ts)
- Per-call counts, latency, arguments, results or error rates for tools
- Recording unauthenticated or refused (401/403/503) requests
- Sending any raw client name, version, title, URL, token, token id, OAuth client id, caller key, IP, path or tool argument
- Telemetry from the services/ Workers or the phone app
- Writing any new file under ~/.overdeck from connector surfaces

autoDecisions.summary: Observe HTTP surfaces before the SDK transport and stdio via an onmessage accessor, through one shared tracker module, instead of only inside server.ts
autoDecisions.rationale: SDK 1.30.1 validateProtocolVersion answers 400 for a 2026-07-28 header before any server hook, so a server.ts-only hook would never see the clients the migration decision depends on

autoDecisions.summary: mcp_session_seen uses the requested protocolVersion from initialize, else the _meta key, else the MCP-Protocol-Version header
autoDecisions.rationale: The SDK silently answers unsupported requests with 2025-11-25; the requested value is the migration signal

autoDecisions.summary: mcp_auth domain is agent_token, oauth, access_token, connector; device and none dropped
autoDecisions.rationale: /mcp and pan mcp serve refuse device credentials and unauthenticated requests before observation, so device and none could never be sent; plain Copy-MCP-URL tokens need access_token
They are Overdeck-managed ACP harnesses that spawn pan mcp serve and would otherwise all read other
Keeps mcp_auth accurate at a bounded cost of at most four events per surface/client/protocol per day

autoDecisions.summary: Persist dedupe in ~/.overdeck/telemetry-mcp-seen.json for dashboard and stdio surfaces; connector surfaces dedupe in memory only
autoDecisions.rationale: pan mcp serve runs one process per agent session, so memory-only dedupe would send one event per session; the connector adds no new file under ~/.overdeck
The connector already runs inside the CLI telemetry lifecycle (cli_command_run), which applies the same opt-out and install id

autoDecisions.summary: mcp_tool_called is presence-per-day with no count_bucket
autoDecisions.rationale: A correct daily count needs cross-process merging, restarts would send partial counts, and count_bucket tops at 11+; install-days per tool and client is the coarse signal

autoDecisions.summary: The PostHog MCP usage dashboard is delivered as insight definitions in docs/TELEMETRY.md; creating it in PostHog is a post-merge operator step
autoDecisions.rationale: Creating it needs PostHog write access the work agent lacks, and it has no data until the events ship

narrative.Action: See .pan/drafts/PAN-5083.md W-3 and decisions D-6, D-7, D-10, D-11, D-12. Export telemetryBlockedForProcess from service.ts. McpUsageTelemetry with injectable analytics/now/enabled/ledgerFile; synchronous never-throwing noteRequest and noteToolCall; in-memory key set cleared on UTC day change; caller-key -> client map capped at 256; persisted surfaces (dashboard_http, public_http, stdio) load ~/.overdeck/telemetry-mcp-seen.json once per day and write it tmp+rename through a serialized promise chain tracked by trackAnalyticsTask; connector surfaces memory only. mcpTelemetryEnabled default. observeMcpTransport installs an onmessage accessor before connect. Async fs only (node:fs/promises). observeMcpTransport setter rule: when the assigned value is not a function, store it unwrapped; the getter returns whatever was stored.

items.title: Given two identical initialize messages on one UTC day, when noteRequest runs twice, then exactly one mcp_session_seen capture is emitted
Given a key already written to the ledger file that day, when a new McpUsageTelemetry on the same file notes it, then no capture is emitted
Given a connector_http or connector_stdio label, when a session is noted, then a capture is emitted and the ledger file is never created
Given OVERDECK_TELEMETRY=0 with VITEST and NODE_ENV cleared, when a tracker using the default enabled notes a session, then no capture is emitted and no ledger file is created
Given a throwing analytics client, when noteRequest and noteToolCall run, then neither throws
Record mcp_tool_called in the tools/call handler of src/lib/mcp/server.ts

narrative.Action: See .pan/drafts/PAN-5083.md W-4. createOverdeckMcpServer gains an optional third argument usage?: { label: McpUsageLabel; telemetry?: McpUsageTelemetry }. After a successful byName lookup in the CallToolRequestSchema handler and before tool.run, call (usage.telemetry ?? mcpUsageTelemetry).noteToolCall(usage.label, tool.name, request.params) inside try/catch, only when usage is given. Update the module header comment to list ../telemetry/mcp.js. tests/unit/lib/mcp/harness.ts stays unchanged.

items.title: Given a server created with a label and an injected tracker, when a client calls list_conversations twice, then exactly one mcp_tool_called capture with mcp_tool list_conversations is emitted
Given a server created without the usage argument, when a tool is called, then no capture is emitted
Given a tools/call for an unknown tool name, when it is handled, then the server returns the existing Unknown tool error and emits no capture
Label and observe dashboard /mcp requests before the SDK transport

narrative.Action: See .pan/drafts/PAN-5083.md W-5 and D-1, D-11. McpRouteDeps gains usage?: McpUsageTelemetry. After the credential checks build the label: surface public_http when isTailscaleFunnelRequest(headers) else dashboard_http; auth mcpAuthForToken(credential); callerKey credential.oauthClientId ?? credential.tokenId. In serveMcpRequest parse the body (skip on JSON error) and call usage.noteRequest(label, parsed, headers.get('mcp-protocol-version') ?? undefined) before transport.handleRequest; pass { label, telemetry: usage } to createOverdeckMcpServer. Refused requests (401/403/503) are never observed.

items.title: Given an initialize from clientInfo.name claude-code with protocolVersion 2025-11-25 and a plain token, when POST /mcp runs, then the tracker emits mcp_session_seen with dashboard_http, 2025-11-25, claude_code, access_token
Given a tools/list with header MCP-Protocol-Version 2026-07-28 and the _meta protocol key, when POST /mcp runs, then the response status is 400 and mcp_session_seen records mcp_protocol 2026-07-28
Given a request with no credential, when POST /mcp answers 401, then no capture is emitted
Given an OAuth token over Tailscale Funnel with Public MCP enabled, when an initialize is posted, then mcp_session_seen records mcp_surface public_http and mcp_auth oauth
Label and observe pan mcp serve stdio messages

narrative.Action: See .pan/drafts/PAN-5083.md W-6. McpServeDeps gains usage?: McpUsageTelemetry. Create the StdioServerTransport first, build { surface: 'stdio', auth: mcpAuthForToken(record), callerKey: 'stdio' }, call observeMcpTransport(transport, label, usage) before server.connect, and pass { label, telemetry: usage } to createOverdeckMcpServer. Load the telemetry modules in the existing Promise.all dynamic import.

narrative.Action: See .pan/drafts/PAN-5083.md W-7 and D-7, D-8. startConnectorHttp and serveConnectorStdio inputs gain usage?: McpUsageTelemetry. metadata.sizeJustification: One event pipeline must land on every MCP surface at once, and the contract/docs drift test forces the contract and docs/TELEMETRY.md into the same change, so the touched subsystems (contracts, lib/telemetry, lib/mcp, dashboard server, cli, docs) cannot ship as separate issues.
